title: MEIKO — As A Fan〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Beyond The Dream of That Day

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you all for your advice.
I have a much better idea of what to do now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: See you later, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, see you!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Haruka seemed much better compared to when she arrived just earlier.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I'm glad we could help.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, I didn't realize how tough it could be to decide whether or not to appear on TV...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me neither...
Especially since it's a big opportunity for MORE MORE JUMP! to really increase their name recognition.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it is. But Shizuku and Airi have had some bad experiences in the past...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which means it's incredibly important right now for them to give this appearance a lot of thought. For them and the sake of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But as things stand... I'd like to see them on TV.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As long as they remain true to their feelings, I believe that everyone will hear their message loud and clear.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, me too♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, they're really going to be on TV...! They've come such a long way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, they have. Former top idols being in this group has also attracted a lot of attention.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And successfully putting on a solo show has only given them a bigger boost.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's so awesome!
I wish I could go on TV! I bet it'd be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, by the way, Rin, what kind of program would you like to be on?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm... A music one!
I wanna sing and dance and make everybody smile!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I see.
That sounds like a primetime music program.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, what about you guys?
What kinds of TV shows would you want to be on?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think I'd like to appear on a variety show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How fun would it be to do one of those quiz segments and the winner gets to perform a song?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that does sound fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Right?
Oh, but I'm also interested in documentaries.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I can see it now.
“It was a long road that was full of obstacles, but these girls overcame all of that to reach this stage.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It'd be so dramatic too! With tears, laughter, everything!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You really do love those kinds of stories, huh♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I do!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How about you, Miku, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hmm... TV...
Oh, it might be fun to do an on-location one!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Traveling to various cities, interviewing the people who live there and seeing beautiful sights sounds really interesting!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. That sounds like a fun travel show.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As for me, a show that lets me eat all kinds of delicious food to my heart's content would be perfect♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hang on one second. We were talking about what kinds of TV shows we'd all like to appear on. You just sound like someone with an empty stomach.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, what do you think Len and KAITO would say if we asked them about this?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to know as well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Variety shows may suit him, but I have a feeling that Len would want to star in a TV drama.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I remember him mentioning the other day that he wants to learn how to be a more expressive singer and hone his acting skills.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I didn't know that...! Len's really talented, so I bet he'd be a wonderful actor.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, what about KAITO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd say a show that involves animals. I have a feeling that he'd enjoy taking care of little critters.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that sounds perfect!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now I'm curious. Why don't we go find them and ask them for ourselves?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good idea. It'll be interesting to see if we guessed correctly♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, let's go ask them!

rows.Speaker: Luka, Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Yeah♪
